<div class="content__wrapper">
      <div class="grid__container"><h1>Kite Camp Booking request</h1></div>
<div class="inhalt__wrapper">
  <div class="grid__container">
    <div class="inhalt__text">
      <p><strong>IMPORTANT!!!</strong></p>
<p>In order for a camp to take place, we need a minimum number of participants (see terms and conditions). We will only confirm the camp once the minimum number of participants has registered.</p>
<p><strong>Please do not book flights before we have confirmed the camp!</strong></p>
<p><br /></p>
